name: Герои Эхо недели нежити — народ красных скал, отбивший нашествие Та-Нехема «Поход Неувядающих» (ADR-0023, ADR-0024; docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Нежить — Та-Нехем»; RS.weeks в design/ui/roster.js). Пятеро по герою за цикл II–VI: c2-54 Тиумет Бальзам, c3-55 Ашеп Серп, c4-48 Урсет Соль и Ладан, c5-54 Иненх Щит Скалы, c6-55 Мехи Огонь в Песке. Задание 30.09.2026: портреты для окон призыва и Эхо вместо инициалов. Рецепт — принятый отряд Иш-Кантуна (jobs/heroes-echo-ishkantun.json) и способ «Глубокий промт персонажа» (art/style/style.md); в рамке — нижний край режет фигуру по поясу, низ плавно уходит в тень без плашки. Раса — Забытые, облик ни на кого из нынешних не похож. Народ красных скал — решение агента по главам: высокие и длиннокостные, долгие глаза тёплого янтаря, кожа тёплого тёмного тона с медным отливом, как их скалы, и россыпь бледно-золотых веснушек; волосы в высоком узле на красном шнуре; лён, пальмовое волокно, яшма, раковины, медь; мёртвых кладут в расщелины под камни, бальзамы — для живых. Враги недели — Неувядающие Та-Нехема: спелёнутые мёртвые в соли и льне, золотые маски, шакалоголовые стражи, колесницы из костей (jobs/echo-tanehem.json) — только трофеи и угроза за правым краем, без черепов, гнили и ужасов. Класс — по оружию и действию, школа — по цвету света. Детали, которых нет в «кто он» и главах, — решение агента, по строке в source
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, heroic character art: a powerful pose, a low camera, strong light from below. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms; the face, the hands and the weapon get the most detail. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no hieroglyphs, no rows of small signs or little pictures on walls or objects, no runes or markings that look like writing, no glyphs, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no dark band at the bottom, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no skeletons of people, no rotting flesh, no blood, no horror. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin; no empty eyes. The hero is alive and warm: no linen wrappings on the hero's body, no gold mask and no jackal head on the hero.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame, whatever the pose. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge, and the face is seen in three-quarter view looking to the right. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they are; the pose carries weight and intent. Head in the upper third, the face large, well lit and readable at small size, with a clear expression. The lower part of the picture sinks gradually into deeper shadow — no band, no plate, nothing written. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

The hero belongs to the people of the red cliffs — a forgotten people who lived long before all the peoples of today, among cliffs and gorges of red sandstone at the edge of the desert, across the river from the kingdom of Ta-Nehem. They laid their dead in clefts of the rock under stones, and they made balms for the living. They look unlike any people living now: tall and long-boned, with long oval faces, high foreheads, narrow straight noses and long eyes of warm amber-gold; their skin is a warm deep brown with a coppery-red sheen, like the rock of their cliffs, with a scatter of pale-gold freckles across the cheekbones and shoulders; their black hair is very long and bound high on the head in one knot wrapped with red cord. They wear short kilts and wraps of undyed linen, capes of woven palm fibre, broad collars of red jasper and white shell beads and copper bracelets; their tools are flint, copper and bronze. Their enemies were the Undying of Ta-Nehem — the risen dead of a river kingdom of reeds and sand, dried with salt and wrapped in linen so that their form would not leave them, with gold masks, jackal-headed guards, chariots of bone and swarms of black beetles, who marched on the living to lead them into their eternal kingdom; dignified and eerie, never rotting; such things appear only as trophies or as the threat beyond the right edge.

jobs.title: Тиумет Бальзам — Забытые, лекарь, Вода (c2-54, Эхо, уникальная)
jobs.source: roster.js c2-54: «Из народа красных скал… Знала бальзамы для живых, а не для мёртвых, и лечила тех, кого задели Неувядающие»; глава «Бальзам для живых»: девочкой носила за реку смолу; касание мёртвых сушило, как соль; бальзам возвращал живым тепло; последнюю чашку отдала мальчику у колодца; не оглянулась. Решение агента: миг лечения у колодца — ладонь с бальзамом вправо; последняя чашка в дальней руке; белая соляная пыль на предплечье — след касания мёртвых. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c2-54-tiumet__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-54.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Tiumet the Balm, a woman of the red cliffs, a healer of the Water school. Who she is: as a girl she carried resin across the river to Ta-Nehem and learned their balms, but she anointed the living, not the dead: against cracks, burns and the sun. When the Undying marched out of their tombs, their touch dried people like salt — the skin tightened, the legs went numb and walked by themselves after the wrapped dead; her balm gave the living back their warmth, and they stayed. Right now she anoints the arm of someone at the well while the dead come near. Character: gentle, brave and resolute — she does not look back; her face soft and set at once, her eyes shining with tenderness and defiance. Pose, the moment of healing: the camera is low; she stands at a stone well, turned toward the right, leaning forward. She has exactly two arms: her near hand reaches toward the right, fingers glistening with glowing amber balm, and cool blue light of the Water school flows from them toward the one beyond the right edge; her far hand holds a small clay cup of balm against her chest — the last one. Details that tell her story: (1) her fingers are sticky and golden with resin; (2) a satchel of small sealed clay jars at her hip; (3) a broad collar of red jasper and white shell beads; (4) fine white salt dust clings to her far forearm where the skin has begun to tighten — a touch of the dead; (5) her long hair is knotted high with red cord. Place: a stone well at the foot of the red cliffs at dusk: palm trees, the desert beyond, and from the right the long shadows of tall linen-wrapped figures stretching across the sand. Blue light of the Water school rises from the water in the well below.

jobs.title: Ашеп Серп — Забытые, физ ДД силы, Земля (c3-55, Эхо, уникальная)
jobs.source: roster.js c3-55: «Жнец народа красных скал, резавший повязки мёртвых царей серпом. Без повязок Неувядающие рассыпались в песок»; главы «Серп» (жал ячмень на узкой полосе под красными скалами; ударил, как режут сноп, — по перевязи; под полотном песок в форме человека), «Повязки» (узел, шов; цари в семь слоёв; жуки, чёрные, как угли). Решение агента: широкий взмах бронзовым серпом вправо — полотно у края расходится, льётся золотой песок; колосья в руке и за поясом; чёрный жук на плече. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c3-55-ashep__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-55.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Ashep the Sickle, a man of the red cliffs, a warrior of great strength of the Earth school. Who he is: a reaper of barley on the narrow strip by the river under the red cliffs, where the earth feeds only those who bend down. The Undying came at harvest time and walked straight through the grain; he struck the first one with his sickle the way one cuts a sheaf — across the binding — and the linen parted, and under it there was no man, only sand in the shape of a man, which crumbled at his feet. He learned where each wrapping has its knot and its seam, and he reaped them. Right now a wrapped dead king in a gold mask comes at him through the barley. Character: stubborn, grim and tireless — a peasant who does his work; his jaw set, his brows lowered, his eyes cold and fixed on the knot of the linen. Pose, the moment of the cut: the camera is low; he sweeps toward the right, his torso twisting through the stroke. He has exactly two arms: his near hand swings a large bronze sickle in a wide arc toward the right, cutting through bands of grey linen at the right edge of the picture; the linen bursts apart and a torrent of golden sand pours out of it; his far hand is thrust back for balance, clutching a handful of cut barley. Amber-orange light of the Earth school flashes along the curve of the blade. Details that tell his story: (1) the sickle's wooden handle is dark with years of sweat; (2) barley straw is tucked in his belt and stuck to his sweaty arms; (3) strips of cut grey linen flutter around him; (4) a black beetle crawls on his shoulder; (5) his long hair is knotted high with red cord; a short kilt of undyed linen. Place: a narrow field of ripe barley by the river under towering red cliffs at dusk; reeds along the water. Amber light rises from the cracked earth below; dusk light on the cliffs.

jobs.title: Урсет Соль и Ладан — Забытые, контроль (на дебаффы), Огонь (c4-48, Эхо, уникальная)
jobs.source: roster.js c4-48: «Жрица, сыпавшая соль и горящий ладан на мёртвых Та-Нехема. От соли они слабели, от дыма теряли дорогу»; главы «Соль» (жрица соли с высохших озёр; поняла, что мёртвые высушены их же солью; сыпала горстями, как сеют), «Горящий ладан» (мёртвые ходят по запаху дома; уносила ладан в пустыню), «Потерянная дорога» (соляной круг). Решение агента: миг сева — веер соли вправо, в дальней руке высоко — бронзовая чаша с горящим ладаном на цепи; мешок соли у бедра; соляной круг на песке. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c4-48-urset__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-48.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Urset of Salt and Incense, a woman of the red cliffs, a priestess and controller of the Fire school who weakens her foes. Who she is: she was the priestess of salt taken from the dry lakes of the red cliffs, and blessed every sack that went across the river to Ta-Nehem to dry their dead — and when the dead marched on her people, she understood they were dried with her own salt. She went out to them with a sack and threw the salt by handfuls, the way one sows: the salt drew the last moisture of the balm out of them, and they stumbled and sat down in the sand. The dead walked by smell, toward whatever smelled of home — so she lit incense in bowls and led them away into the desert. Right now she sows salt at the dead. Character: stern, proud and ashamed — a priestess who cannot look the living in the eyes; her face severe, her eyes reddened by smoke, her lips pressed tight. Pose, the moment of the sowing: the camera is low; she strides toward the right, her body turning into the throw. She has exactly two arms: her near arm flings a broad, glittering fan of white salt toward the right, like a sower casting seed; her far hand holds high a bronze bowl of burning incense on a chain, trailing thick fragrant smoke that glows red and orange (Fire). Details that tell her story: (1) a heavy sack of salt hangs at her hip; (2) her fingers are white with salt; (3) a long robe of undyed linen with a collar of red jasper; (4) coils of scented smoke wind around her like ribbons; (5) a ring of white salt is poured on the sand around her. Place: the desert beyond the red cliffs at night, the cliffs a red line far behind; from the right, a column of tall linen-wrapped figures follows the smoke. Scarlet-orange light of the Fire school glows from the incense and from the embers in the sand below.

jobs.title: Иненх Щит Скалы — Забытые, танк, Земля (c5-54, Эхо, уникальная)
jobs.source: roster.js c5-54: «Держал проход в красных скалах, куда шли колесницы из костей. За ним прятали живых, и ни одного не увели»; главы «Проход в скалах» (два шага шириной; медный щит, почерневший от рук дедов), «Колесницы из костей» (кости на медной проволоке; встретил щитом в лоб — рассыпались, как хворост; Урсет сыпала соль на обломки), «Живые за спиной», «Щит у скалы». Решение агента: удар щитом в колесницу у правого края; дальняя ладонь упёрта в скалу; соль вдоль прохода; огоньки укрытых в глубине ущелья. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c5-54-inenh__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c5-54.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Inenh Shield-of-the-Rock, a man of the red cliffs, a defender of the Earth school. Who he is: in the red cliffs there was a pass two steps wide — outside, the desert; inside, a gorge with water, where his people hid from every trouble they remembered. He guarded it as his grandfathers had, with a copper shield blackened by their hands. When the Undying came, the living were led into the gorge, and he stood in the pass; not one of the living was taken from behind his back. Right now a chariot of bones rushes into the pass. Character: unshakable, weary and quietly tender — he counts by the crying of the children behind him that they are alive; his jaw set, his brows lowered, his eyes calm and fixed on the chariot. Pose, the moment of the impact: the camera is low; he stands in the narrow pass between two walls of red rock, turned toward the right, his shoulders driven forward. He has exactly two arms: his near arm rams a round copper shield, blackened and dented by generations, forward toward the right into the front of a chariot made of pale bones bound with copper wire at the right edge of the picture, and the bones scatter like dry brushwood; his far hand is braced flat against the rock wall. Amber-orange light of the Earth school bursts from the rock under the impact. Details that tell his story: (1) the old copper shield is black with age and bent by the blows; (2) scattered bones and snapped copper wire fly through the air; (3) a line of white salt is poured across the floor of the pass; (4) his long hair is knotted high with red cord, sweat and dust on his face; (5) deep in the gorge behind him glows the small warm light of hidden fires. Place: a narrow pass in red sandstone cliffs at night, the desert beyond the right edge. Amber light rises from the cracks in the red rock below.

jobs.title: Мехи Огонь в Песке — Забытые, маг ДД, Огонь (c6-55, Эхо, вневременная)
jobs.source: roster.js c6-55: «Заклинатель огня народа красных скал. Жёг мёртвых Та-Нехема там, где их нельзя было похоронить, — прямо в песке»; главы «Огонь в песке» (закопанный встаёт, заваленный выходит; песок горит, если знать, как попросить, — становится стеклом), «Золотые маски» (золото стекало с масок в стекло), «Шакалы у реки» (песок у переправы стал стеклом на полёт стрелы), «Царь, который не умер», «Пепел и песок». Решение агента: миг заклинания — волна огня катится по песку вправо, песок за ней плавится в светящееся стекло; на шее — кусок стекла с вплавленным золотом маски. jobs.subject: Subject: Mehi Fire-in-the-Sand, a man of the red cliffs, a battle mage of the Fire school. Who he is: his people laid their dead in clefts of the rock under stones; the Undying could not be laid like that — the buried one rises, the walled-in one walks out. He called fire as the old ones called it, for the hearth and the pottery pit, and understood that the dead of Ta-Nehem could only be laid in fire; sand burns if you know how to ask it — it turns to glass. He burned the dead in the sand, and the gold ran from their masks into the glass. Right now he sets the sand on fire before the dead. Character: fierce, grim and implacable — the dead must lie; his face hard, his amber eyes burning, his lips drawn back. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; he stands on the sand by the river, turned toward the right, his body sweeping into the gesture. He has exactly two arms: his near hand sweeps low toward the right, and a wave of fire rolls across the sand toward the dead beyond the right edge, the sand behind it melting into glowing glass; his far hand is raised high, fingers spread, commanding the flames (Fire). Details that tell his story: (1) a lump of glass with molten gold fused inside hangs on a cord at his neck — gold from a mask; (2) his forearms are black with soot to the elbows; (3) a broad collar of red jasper and white shell beads; (4) patches of sand around him have turned to shining glass; (5) his long hair, knotted high with red cord, flies in the heat. Place: the river crossing at night: tall reeds burning along the water, the red cliffs behind, glassy sand glowing. Scarlet-orange light of the Fire school rises from the burning sand below.
